inputs.goal: Discover the Kubernetes cluster resources, deploy a MiniCluster of the same number of nodes and maximum cores available. Use the container ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax and target run lmp -v x X -v y Y -v z Z -in in.reaxff.hns, where X Y and Z describe the problem size. It is up to you maximize the Figure of merit, k-atom or M-atom steps/s on one node. You MUST keep increasing X Y Z until the job does not complete or errors. If the run is successful, parse the log and get the FOM. If not, keep trying to deploy until it is fixed. Keep going until you deem optimized and return all FOMs you have parsed.

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: minicluster-1
  namespace: default
spec:
  size: 1
  tasks: 64
  container:
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
      # This is required for ARM
      architecture: arm64
    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task
  job:
    command: flux submit lmp -v x 10 -v y 10 -v z 10 -in in.reaxff.hns

    # This is the flux runner container

      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task

kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: minicluster-4
  namespace: default

  # Number of pods for the MiniCluster
  size: 1
  # This is the number of tasks for the job
  tasks: 64

  # This is the main container that will run the command
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      command: lmp -v x 30 -v y 30 -v z 30 -in in.reaxff.hns

  # Flux options

    # This is the flux runner container
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
    arch: arm64
    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task
